fields.diagnosis: Acute phlegmonous appendicitis with localized peritonitis.
fields.canonical_diagnosis: Acute phlegmonous appendicitis with localized peritonitis.
fields.procedures: Emergency laparoscopic appendectomy and peritoneal cavity irrigation.
fields.follow_up: Surgical outpatient clinic visit in 10 days for wound check and evaluation. Avoid heavy lifting for 4 weeks.
